phase1: only new classifier row; all old rows/shared/box/BN protected exactly; all CW source images each epoch
phase2a: epochs4-10 unfreeze neck+Detect, keep backbone frozen
phase2b: epoch11 onward unfreeze backbone6-9; backbone0-5 remain frozen
BN: running statistics frozen all epochs, affine only in enabled blocks
optimizer: AdamW beta(.9,.999),eps1e-8,wd1e-4 only matrices; no previous optimizer resume
LR: warm new row1e-3 ramp50 updates; phase2 output3e-4/old row effective.2x; neck,bbox,hidden3e-5; backbone6-9 1e-5; cosine to.1x by40, hold for41-50
supervision: BCE only covered or positive entries, unmodified known-GT TAL/box/DFL
retention_teacher: frozen original10 on partial images only; teacher unknown-old P>.5, exclude assigned GT cells; BernoulliKL*.25 + distributionKL*.05; no pseudo labels; absent in inference
checkpoint: EMA standard Detect; best eligible fixed validation fitness=.5 old_score+.5 CWmacroAP95; if none eligible best_any marked FAIL; last independent
retention_gates: BDD person/car/TL/TS AP50 drop<=.05,BDD mean<=.03;S2TL<=.03,relative to original10 same validation
early_stop: after at least30 total epochs,10 epochs since best eligible fitness improvement >=1e-4; never test-driven
extension: at40 extend to50 only if best CWmacroAP95 in36-40 exceeds best31-35 by>=.005 and latest old retention passes
abort: OOM/nonfinite loss or gradient/allocated>6.5GiB/hash mismatch: save ABORTED and stop; no automatic setting change
precision: BF16 forward; all loss/TAL/box/DFL/KD FP32; model/master/optimizer FP32; no gradient scaling
normalization: all windows denominator32, including partial; sum(bs*micro_mean)/32; no samples dropped
validation_precision: FP32 both baseline and candidate, same NMS/coverage/matching as v1
augmentation_rng: same HSV/flip distributions; deterministic keyed by seed/epoch/record_index
recovery: initial + first update + every100 successful updates + epoch boundaries; no automatic retry
